Name: Immersive Saloon
Author: tiakall
Description:
Ever get bored of seeing the same lines over and over whenever you go to visit on Fridays? Me too. This mod adds between two and ten randomized lines, expanding on their vanilla characterization, for the following characters' Saloon-specific dialogue or action strings:

* Sam
* Sebastian
* Willy
* Kent
* Emily
* Gus
* Marnie
* Lewis
* Clint
* Robin
* Demetrius
* Pierre

There's also an option to remove the stool near Lewis, the chair to the left of the pool table, and some or all of the booths, in case your Friday nights are a little *too* crowded to navigate.

[b]Compatibility[/b]: I don't know of any other mods currently that change/add vanilla dialogue for the Saloon, so if there is, it's not currently compatible.  Let me know and I'll see what I can do.  Now with added compatibility for [url=https://diversestardewvalley.weebly.com/]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url] variants.
[b]Translations:[/b] Welcomed! Just link back to this mod so I can link you in return.
[b]Thanks: [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]Lemurkat[/url] for lending me the code to remove the stools, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53724786]TheFrenchDodo[/url] for the mod name, and the folks at the Stardew Modding Community discord for encouraging me as well as helping me find a couple of the more obscure strings.
